# ComfyQ workflow matrix (P1.5)

Every workflow of the classroom ComfyQ, run from Blender through the bridge (`tools\smoke_test.ps1 -Sweep`: whatever is **served** is calibrated by ComfyQ, then booked with scene inputs — clay still / first 2 s of the clay animation / mask / a test sound — and its cheapest settings; the result is downloaded and imported). VRAM and time come from ComfyQ's own calibration.

**15 / 66 tested, 15 ok.** Generated by `tools/sweep_matrix.py`.
